summary: Why touches the fingertips to the forehead and pulls away into a Y handshape, with lowered eyebrows. Think of pulling the question out of your head.
handshape: Open hand closing to a Y
movement: Fingertips touch the forehead, hand pulls away and closes to a Y
steps: Touch the fingertips of an open hand to the side of your forehead.
Pull the hand away and down a few inches as the middle three fingers close, leaving a Y (thumb and pinky out).
Eyebrows down. You can wiggle the Y slightly for emphasis.
mistakes: Starting with a Y already formed. The hand starts open at the forehead and becomes a Y as it moves.
